description: §8.5 comparison: pretrained-only vs pretrained+AERIS vs (fine-tuned+AERIS if done)

rows.notes: To compute: run the full AERIS-3D pipeline on each dataset sample and compare survivors' heights against GT DSM. This is implemented but requires the dataset to be present locally.

rows.reason: Apple M2 MPS detected. MPS is suitable for inference but not recommended for fine-tuning a ViT-based depth backbone (insufficient VRAM, slow backward pass). Fine-tuning SKIPPED explicitly. The pretrained-only baseline is the MVP as per §8.4.

notes: All metrics are scale-invariant (both prediction and GT normalized to [0,1]). Absolute metric accuracy requires GSD or reference DEM anchoring.
